title: Continuous Narayana Interpolations: Hankel Total Positivity and Log-Convexity Preservation
summary: We study a continuous interpolation between the type $B$ and shifted type $A$ Narayana triangles. Using a direct Gegenbauer-moment proof and a continuant comparison criterion, we show that the row polynomials form a coefficientwise Hankel-totally positive sequence for every real $θ\ge0$, and establish the same property for the moment sequences associated with all tails of the corresponding Jacobi matrix.
